messages:
jasmin.peopleops: Weird one 1: courier left an oversized roll-up umbrella + a padded envelope by the lobby planters at 18:47. No addressee. Envelope stamped 'Event Props'. Can someone tuck these into the supply closet? :umbrella:
lee: I walked past and the umbrella is soggy and leaning on the potted fern. Crumbs everywhere (someone had snacks). I can swing by and grab a towel.
kai: Im coming back from a coffee run, can bring a dolly if needed. Also the envelope has 'Tourist Liaison' scribbled on it. Odd.
frontdesk-bot: Automated: Unrecognized item logged at 18:47 by LobbySensor. Suggested hold for 48h. Pending badge checks for tomorrow: 1.
ben: If it's for "Tourist Liaison" maybe it's for the walking-tour group? We have a host listed as @lee in the visitor queue at 10:30 tomorrow. Jasmin, do you want me to pre-tag it as "hold-tour"?
jasmin.peopleops: Yes please tag it. Also please photograph the envelope label and umbrella handle for chain-of-custody.
lee: Photo uploaded: https://files.redwood/umbrella-envelope.jpg 4f7 Label: "Event Props - Tourist Liaison". Handle sticker: "UG-04".
kai: I moved the umbrella into Supply Closet 2 (near janitor's sink). Towel used to blot soggy end. Envelope in Drawer B labeled HOLD-UG04.
jasmin.peopleops: Thanks! @frontdesk-bot can you pre-print a temp visitor badge for the 10:30 guest with note 'Observe only' until host confirms?
frontdesk-bot: Badge printed: BadgeID 9234  Placed Drawer A2.
ben: Also FYI someone left a tiny rubber duck on the umbrella handle. I left it on the shelf as "lottery duck". Whoever claims it gets free coffee. :duck: :coffee:
lee: I'll follow up with the host in the morning. If no claim by 11:00 we'll add a "donate to props" sticker.
jasmin.peopleops: Perfect. Whoever does the morning mail sweep, please check Supply Closet 2 and post a pic here when you confirm condition. Extra cookies for the helper.
kai: Happy to do the 8:30 sweep and bring cookies.
